segment_contamination_dimensions: Security/guard function cabins (buyer segment: security deployment buyers seeking guard posts, not office workspace) — terms such as 'security cabin', 'guard cabin', 'guard room', 'frisking booth' are blocked; sibling MCATs Security Cabins (42755), Portable Security Cabins (135705), MS Security Cabins (150853), Prefabricated Security Cabin (181975), FRP Portable Security Cabin (145135) carve out this segment.

Container-converted office structures (buyer segment: buyers specifically seeking shipping-container-grade steel conversion units) — the term 'container office cabin' is excluded from enhanced names to avoid collision with sibling MCAT Office Container (96541); it is retained only in alt_names as a buyer search term where it reflects genuine buyer vocabulary without naming collision.

Wooden/log cabin buyers (buyer segment: buyers seeking timber-frame or log-construction cabins for aesthetic or eco purposes) — terms such as 'wooden cabin', 'log cabin', 'timber cabin' are blocked; sibling MCATs Wooden Cabins (43790), Portable Log Cabins (150362) carve out this segment.

Non-office portable structures (buyer segments: classroom, kitchen, pantry, dressing room, ATM, toll booth, smoking cabin buyers) — enhanced names and alt_names are scoped strictly to office/workspace function to avoid attracting buyers of sibling MCATs Portable Classrooms (35057), Portable Kitchen (135704), Portable Pantry (150362), Portable Dressing Room (149768), Portable ATM Cabin (188230), Toll Booth (135797), Smoking Cabin (111378).
